description: Checks your constraints on ONE offer (and optionally one variant) against the merchant's own data and answers per constraint true, false or unknown, with evidence or the reason. Fields: price {min,max,currency}, available, option {keys,values}, brand {values}, merchant {values}, attribute {keys,values}, barcode {values}, ships_to {value: "IT" or "IT:CB"}. Nothing is inferred or translated: pass the values you accept. Results hold within max_age_seconds (default 86400) of the last merchant confirmation; outside it they are unknown (stale). live=true reads the merchant now. The checkout is the final authority.

live.description: true reads the merchant Bridge now (one request).

variation_id.description: Variant to check (from matching_variants or variants_compact). Without it, variant-dependent constraints may be unknown.

name: verify_offer
title: Verify constraints on one offer (true / false / unknown)
